main_issue: Who gets leave on the two working days around Hari Raya Puasa when only two of four staff can be off and all four want or need to be off

A-B.evidence: Both say they cannot change (T1, T2) and B says 'Make that four of us' (T28); same stance, but they never address each other directly.

A-C.evidence: C says it's about whose turn it is and 'I've done my bit' (T21, T23); A replies 'This isn't about whose turn it is... It can't be my turn' (T19, T22).

A-D.evidence: A sympathizes ('I understand, Agent D') but refuses to cancel (T5, T9, T13); D keeps pressing that Hari Raya is different (T12); A: 'I can't work either' (T25).

B-C.evidence: B says no change (T2) and 'I have no choice' (T28); C wants the days off and says it is someone else's turn (T17); they never address each other.

B-D.evidence: D's 'three of us who can't work' (T26) is answered by B's 'Make that four of us' (T28); both claim the days, with no resolution.

C-D.evidence: D: 'I've only been here a few months' (T16) and 'So it's their turn, then' (T18) against C's 'It's someone else's turn' (T17); both want the days off.
